title: Your First Weekend at Saint Francis University, Shared as Cards
description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence for learning the Loretto campus, connecting with campus life, and ending the weekend with a reflective walk.

cards.title: Start with New Student Orientation
cards.subtitle: Friday morning · campus welcome
cards.notes: Use the orientation sessions to get your bearings, then note the buildings and services you want to revisit once the scheduled program ends.
cards.short_summary: A structured starting point for meeting the campus and planning the rest of the weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis lists New Student Orientation and says Orientation Counselors host guided academic-building tours and activities for new students.
cards.access_notes: Orientation programming is scheduled by the university; consult the current orientation page for details.

cards.title: Get oriented at JFK Student Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus hub
cards.notes: Stop by the Student Center to locate the Center for Student Engagement and take a quick lap of the lower-level student spaces.
cards.short_summary: A practical hub for student engagement, club space, food, and campus services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center for Student Engagement says its office is in JFK Student Center, and the university identifies lower-level club meeting space, a bookstore, DIY room, esports arena, and Frankie’s there.
cards.source_title: JFK Student Center | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: Visit during building operations; specific space availability may vary with events and reservations.

cards.title: Have a first campus meal at Torvian
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · dining hall
cards.notes: Make this a simple meal stop: check the current menu or service window, then use the walk back to notice nearby campus landmarks.
cards.short_summary: The university’s main dining hall, with meal-plan and pay-at-door options described for orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis identifies Torvian as an on-campus dining hall, and its 2026 orientation page lists lunch service there and payment at the door.
cards.access_notes: Dining service and payment options can change; check the university’s current dining information before going.

cards.title: Choose a study spot in the Library and Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · academic reset
cards.notes: Meet a new classmate for a short planning session, identify the floors you will use, and save the library location for future group work.
cards.short_summary: A named campus study destination used for group sessions and academic support.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis Residence Life specifically suggests meeting classmates in the Library and Learning Commons for a group study session.
cards.access_notes: Check library access and service hours before visiting.

cards.title: Make something in the D.I.Y. Room
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · lower-level JFK
cards.notes: Bring a small project idea or browse the supplies, then use the room as a calm way to take a break between welcome-week activities.
cards.short_summary: A craft-focused room in JFK Student Center with supplies for creative projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis identifies a DIY craft room filled with supplies in the lower level of JFK Student Center.
cards.source_title: JFK Student Center | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: Confirm room availability and any material-use guidance with the Student Center.

cards.title: See the Luke Trotz Esports Arena
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · lower-level JFK
cards.notes: Drop in to locate the arena and ask about current student access or programming, especially if gaming is a way you like to meet people.
cards.short_summary: A named esports facility located in the lower level of JFK Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis describes the Luke Trotz Esports Arena as a cornerstone of the lower-level JFK Student Center.
cards.source_title: Esports at SFU | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: Ask the Esports program about current access, equipment, and event availability.

cards.title: Find DeGol Arena before game day
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon · Stokes Athletic Center
cards.notes: Walk through the Stokes Athletics Center area and save the arena location, so attending a future Red Flash event feels straightforward.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing Red Flash athletics venue inside Maurice Stokes Athletics Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis says DeGol Arena in the Maurice Stokes Athletics Center has been home to Red Flash Athletics for more than 50 years.
cards.access_notes: Event entry, seating, and facility access depend on the athletics schedule and venue policies.

cards.title: Take the paved walk to the Grotto
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning · outdoor reflection
cards.notes: Follow the paved path across from Cafe Gubbio, pause to view the shrine and Stations of the Cross, and keep the visit quiet and respectful.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor spiritual space with a Lourdes replica, Pietà, Nativity scene, and Stations of the Cross.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis says the Grotto includes a replica of Our Lady of Lourdes, the Pietà, a Nativity scene, and Stations of the Cross, reached by a paved path.
cards.access_notes: Use the paved path described by the university and respect the site’s reflective purpose.

cards.title: Step into Immaculate Conception Chapel
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning · campus chapel
cards.notes: If it fits your interests, visit during a listed service or simply spend a few quiet minutes looking at the restored chapel before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel with daily, weekend, and holy-day Masses that welcomes students and local residents.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis states that Immaculate Conception Chapel holds daily, weekend, and holy-day Masses and welcomes students, teachers, and local residents.
cards.source_title: Immaculate Conception Chapel | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: The university publishes a Mass and prayer schedule; consult it for current service times.

cards.title: Close with a walk through Schwab Gardens
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Mount Assisi Friary
cards.notes: Take an unhurried public-viewing walk through the gardens, then use the setting as a final landmark to remember from your first weekend.
cards.short_summary: Italian Renaissance-style gardens at the former Charles M. Schwab estate, now Mount Assisi Friary.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis says Schwab Gardens at Mount Assisi Friary are open for public viewing and were designed by Charles Wellford Leavitt Jr.
cards.access_notes: The university describes the gardens as open for public viewing; observe posted conditions while visiting.
